subject: Private Offer: Nova Health — approval gates, billing cadence, and PO handoff
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@novahealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 07 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Private offer questions / approval flow

Hi Jordan,

Thanks for the demo yesterday — the team was impressed with the latency numbers and the KV cache behavior. Procurement has a few practical questions before we can sign: 1) Nova needs a clear buyer-approval gating: who signs the private offer — is it the BU finance lead or corporate procurement? 2) For pricing, we prefer an annual commitment but we need the option to switch to usage billing after the first year if adoption lags. Can you do a 12-month firm term with a 12-month option-to-convert to pay-as-you-go, or is 36 months the minimum for the price level we discussed? 3) Our procurement team requires a standard PO process and a vendor risk questionnaire before countersign.

Can you outline how Redwood handles buyer approvals and PO handoffs for AWS private offers so I can share with procurement?

--
Liam O'Connor
Head of AI Product, Nova Health
liam.oconnor@novahealth.com
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@novahealth.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 07 Apr 2027 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private offer questions / approval flow

Liam — thanks for the clear list, great questions. High level answers first, then detail: 1) Buyer approval: the private offer is generated in AWS Marketplace and executed by your procurement lead (PO) or signer. On our side we can route approvals internally — deals under $150k can be handled by Sales+Acct Exec; larger or discounted deals need RevOps and sales leadership sign-off. 2) Term & billing: we can issue a 12-month private offer at the price you saw; conversion to usage after year 1 is operationally negotiable but needs a clause in the SOW and typically a pricing re-evaluation. 3) PO handoff: we accept a PO referencing the AWS private offer ID; we can also provide a vendor packet (SOC 2 report, data handling summary) for risk review.

I'll loop Vanessa and Kar to confirm discount approvals and to prepare the vendor packet and a sample SOW that includes the conversion option language you mentioned. Does procurement have a preferred DocuSign or PO template?

Thanks,
Jordan
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
From: procurement@novahealth.com
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@novahealth.com>, Nova Health - Legal <legal@novahealth.com>
Date: Wed, 07 Apr 2027 14:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private offer questions / approval flow

Jordan — procurement here. Quick notes: 1) Nova's approval gate is two-step: BU Finance signs for contracts < $250k ARR; corporate procurement + legal must sign for anything with vendor risk exceptions or multi-year commitments > $250k. 2) PO process: we will issue a PO referencing the AWS private offer ID and attach our standard vendor terms (we expect vendor acceptance via DocuSign or email acknowledgment). 3) Vendor risk: please provide SOC 2 Type II (latest), data handling appendix, and your breach notification SLA. Once we have the packet and private offer draft, legal will triage any term exceptions.

Attached: procurement_template.pdf (application/pdf)

Procurement Team
Nova Health
procurement@novahealth.com
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@novahealth.com>, procurement@novahealth.com
Date: Thu, 08 Apr 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Private offer questions / approval flow

Vanessa / Karthik — forwarding Nova's procurement note. Key asks: SOC 2, data handling appendix, and a PO-friendly private offer flow. Pricing ask from Liam: 12-month firm with an option to convert to usage after 12 months (no penalties) OR 36 months at discounted rate. If we price a 12-month firm term at the demo numbers, we should expect a smaller discount band; 36 months unlocks deeper pricing. Can we do a one-time conversion clause in the SOW for the 12->usage path and still protect revenue expectations?

Proposed internal decision path: 1) Approve 12-month private offer at list price + minimal onboarding credit (no revenue commit), commit to providing a conversion clause (legal to scope), OR 2) Approve 36-month at 10% deeper discount if Nova takes the multi-year. Need sign-off from RevOps for any price below list and from Contracts for the conversion clause.

Can you confirm banding and who signs? I put a rough deadline of Friday EOD for a first-pass offer to keep the deal moving.

--
Jordan
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@novahealth.com>
Cc: procurement@novahealth.com
Date: Fri, 09 Apr 2027 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private offer questions / approval flow — offer sent

All — quick update & next steps: 1) We prepared two private offer drafts in AWS Marketplace: (A) 12-month firm term at the demo price with a documented conversion clause to shift to usage billing at the end of month 12 (conversion triggers a 30-day notice and adoption metric review), and (B) 36-month committed term at a 12% discount. 2) Vendor packet attached: Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2027.pdf, Data_Handling_Addendum.pdf, Breach_SLA.pdf. 3) I created a HubSpot deal and attached the marketplace offer IDs: OFFER-12M-NEE-554 and OFFER-36M-NEE-555 (link below). 4) We sent the 12-month private offer to Liam's procurement contact via AWS private offer and shared a DocuSign envelope for the SOW and conversion clause so Nova Legal can review.

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2027.pdf (application/pdf); Data_Handling_Addendum.pdf (application/pdf); Breach_SLA.pdf (application/pdf); SOW_Redwood_Nova_v1.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/sandbox/envelope/0A12B3C4D5E6F
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/DEAL-98765

Liam — once procurement confirms the PO template path we will accept the PO referencing OFFER-12M-NEE-554. If Nova prefers the 36-month discounted path, please confirm and we will withdraw the 12-month offer and proceed with OFFER-36M-NEE-555.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Marketplace & Partnerships | Redwood Inference
